title: The bird at the Rain
logline: The thirtieth January, and the bird on the sill with the four jars, inside, in the rain's light, the same place as 2024. The last Rain the book takes. The bird's sequence has two pages left.

panels.composition: The casement window in January rain from inside: four jars on the sill and the small rainbow bird among them, the rain's gray light, an old three-legged dog asleep in the bed below.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage window in January rain seen from inside with four jars on the sill and a small rainbow bird standing among them, an old three-legged dog asleep in a bed below, no words
image.notes: The thirtieth Rain; the last the book takes.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The thirtieth Rain. The bird on the sill.
